story.title: The Lamp at the Estate Sale Took Everything Back

sentences.text: I bought the tarnished brass lamp at a damp estate sale on Tuesday, unaware of the cost attached to every wish.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: My first two wishes brought wealth and health, but the police report later noted my savings and my brother both vanished without a trace.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: By 4:03 AM on the third night, my reflection in the antique glass started moving before I did.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Thick ash smoke poured from the spout, and a raspy voice whispered directly into my ear.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: I demand the final payment now.
sentences.speaker: creature

sentences.text: Golden eyes blinked through the rising smoke at exactly 4:04, reaching out to claim the last thing I owned.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Would you have left the lamp unrubbed?
sentences.speaker: narrator
